title: Microtrail Cost Tiler — compact token-provenance pane with role-aware CSV export
creator: Anika Rao
description:
Problem statement: customers need a compact, exportable view to trace per-invocation token spend from session -> message -> token-level slices and quickly produce role-aware CSV exports for chargeback or SOC audits. Current console views are either too verbose (full ledger) or too abstract (aggregated dashboards), making it hard to reconcile a surprise spike to specific user flows or pipeline steps.

Goal: design a narrow, embeddable 'Microtrail Cost Tiler' pane that surfaces a condensed token-provenance timeline (sparkline + breadcrumbs), per-slice attribution badges (model, route, quantization profile, cached vs cold token), and an export composer that generates CSV/NDJSON with role-aware columns (team, project, route, token_count, model_variant, quantization, cache_hit, unit_rate, total_cost). The component should be embeddable in Session Detail, Route Explorer, and Export Workbench.

Success criteria / acceptance criteria:
- Visual: single-column compact tile that fits in dashboard sidebars and a larger expanded sheet. Sparkline shows token-rate heatmap by 1s buckets with hover tooltips. Breadcrumbs show session->message->slice with clickable links. Attribution badges appear with micro-interactions to reveal exact token counts.
- Export: UI allows selecting scope (session / route / time-range), role-based column presets (engineer, finance, security), and format (CSV/NDJSON). Exports must include stable identifiers for traceability (session_id, message_id, slice_id, model_sha).
- Perf: the tile must render in <120ms for 500 sessions and stream incremental rows when used in large exports.
- Accessibility: keyboard-navigable, color-contrast compliant, and labels for screen readers on token badges and export controls.
- Observability: links to cost breakdown route and underlying query parameters, with a single-click drilldown to the Cost Ledger panel and the underlying SQL/OLAP query preview.

Design notes & components:
- Compact tile header: title, scope dropdown, quick-export CTA, and small kebab for options.
- Sparkline area: condensed heatmap with a subtle gradient and token-rate y-axis on hover only. Hover reveals mini tooltip with time, token_count, estimated_cost, cache_hit_rate.
- Provenance breadcrumbs: horizontal compact list with small avatars for team/role, truncated labels, and chevrons. Clicking opens the session/message sheet with the tile in context.
- Attribution badges: micro-pill chips for attributes (model, quantization, route, cached/cold). Clicking a badge opens a micro-panel listing contributing slices with exact token counts and percent contribution.
- Export composer modal: left column for scope & filters, middle column for preview of rows (paginated stream), right column for column toggles and role-presets. Presets: engineer (detailed), finance (aggregated + cost), security (audit fields).
- CSV schema (required fields): session_id, message_id, slice_id, timestamp, team, project, route, model_variant, quantization_profile, cache_hit, tokens_input, tokens_output, token_unit_rate_usd, total_cost_usd, annotations

Edge cases & trade-offs noted:
- Large exports: we recommend server-side async export with email/console notification. In-UI streaming preview limited to first 1,000 rows.
- Privacy: session identifiers may be PII-adjacent; implement a toggle to hash identifiers for exports when customer opts in.
- Cost estimation vs final cost: display both estimated and billed columns with a clear tooltip explaining potential deltas due to reruns or post-processing.

Prototype links and notes:
- Figma prototype (compact -> expanded -> export): https://redwood.company.figma.com/file/microtrail/compact-export-prototype (view-only)
- Confluence PRD: https://redwood.company.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/456789/Microtrail+Cost+Tiler+PRD
- Dev handoff board: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pulls/2489 (design->dev comments included)

Implementation hints for eng:
- Use existing sparkline component and extend to support heatmap bands and inline tooltips.
- Backend: provide paginated rows endpoint /api/costs/microtrail?scope=session&id=...&cursor=... returning minimal tokens and attribution metadata. Include a presigned export job trigger endpoint.
- Export performance: prioritize async exports for >10k rows with job status and signed download link.

Open questions:
1) Should exports default to hashed identifiers for all customers or opt-in per workspace? (Security asked for opt-in)
2) How many role-presets should we ship initially? (PM suggests three: engineer, finance, security)
3) Backfill: do we backfill token provenance for >90 days by default or make it a retention opt-in? (cost implications)

Delivery notes: ready for engineering refinement. Prototype includes annotated spacing tokens and CSS vars. Need final review from PM on CSV column naming and from Security on identifier hashing flow.
